item.title: ​The EBA supports the NGFS Declaration on the macro-financial dimension of the energy transition on the occasion of COP31
item.description: ​As an active member of the Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS), the European Banking Authority (EBA) welcomes the publication of the NGFS Declaration on the macro-financial dimension of the energy transition on the occasion of the 2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye. The Declaration highlights how energy price shocks and increasingly frequent climate-related shocks are becoming a macro-financial reality, and calls for an orderly, whole-economy transition. — Thématique finance ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact énergie / commerce.
